cohort: 61 pregnant women positive for SARS-CoV-2 infection at the time of delivery
finding: Symptomatic pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection at delivery have more frequently altered laboratory parameters compared to asymptomatic women, but no significant difference in preterm delivery, cesarean section rate, birth weight, or Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Symptomatic pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection at the delivery show more often altered laboratory parameters compared with asymptomatic ones; nevertheless, they have a slightly higher but non-significant rate of cesarean section, compared with asymptomatic women.
